description: Block DOCTYPE declarations carrying an internal DTD subset ([, with or without a preceding space) or an external DTD (SYSTEM/PUBLIC). A plain <!DOCTYPE html> does not match. HEADERS dropped: XML never arrives in request headers.
Block external SYSTEM identifiers in either quote style (XML allows single quotes; the old pattern only matched double) across the schemes used for exfiltration and wrapper tricks.
Block external entity declarations, including parameter entities (<!ENTITY % xxe SYSTEM ...>, the blind-XXE workhorse the old \w+ requirement missed) and single-quoted system identifiers.
Log attempts to use XXE to include sensitive paths.
